newsitem.title: USA: Avecor acts to improve margins.
newsitem.headline: Avecor acts to improve margins.

text.p: Avecor Cardiovascular Inc said Monday the company, which posted lower third-quarter earnings, has made a number of changes aimed at improving its margins.
Chief executive officer Anthony Radolato cited selective price increases, sales incentives tied to margin improvement and further efforts to trim manufacturing costs.
"We also expect margins to improve with the introduction of our Affinity blood pump, scheduled for 1997," Radolato said in a statement.
Earlier, Avecor reported third-quarter earnings of $0.08 per share compared with $0.13 in the same 1995 period.
